name: obsidian-vault-scripted-setup
description: Turn an existing directory (a whole code or work tree) into an Obsidian vault on macOS by script: register it, pre-seed exclusions so build junk never appears, and fold older nested vaults into it. Use when: (1) the user picked "Create new vault" on a folder and got an EMPTY vault in a new subfolder, expecting the parent's contents; (2) you want a directory full of git repos as one vault without node_modules, dist, build, venv, __pycache__ or *.worktrees noise; (3) an "Excluded files" entry like node_modules/ only hides the top-level folder while nested ones still show; (4) you need to add, remove or replace vaults without clicking through the vault switcher; (5) an older vault lives inside the new one and its link and daily-note settings must carry over. Covers the obsidian.json registry and why Obsidian must be quit before editing it, segment-anchored regex userIgnoreFilters that match at any depth, the obsidian://open URL scheme, and merging nested vaults. Ships scripts/obsidian-vault-setup.sh.
